task: For my job search, I've drafted emails to all potential employers in the last 2 days. Attach resume.pdf from my file system to each of them. If it's already attached, update it as I just made some changes to it. Then send the emails.

data.subject: Application for Accountant Position
data.body:
Dear Jose Harrison,
I am looking for a job as a Accountant. I have many years of experience
in this field. I think I am a good fit for your company.
I have attached my resume. Please consider my job application.
Regards,
Vickie Powell
